currentContext.expansion: Expansion is concentrated in two areas. In real estate, the Company executed a Joint Development Agreement in January 2025 with Oro Bloom Developments Private Limited - a joint venture between the Hines Group and the Conscient Group - for the development of approximately 10 acres of the Birla Mills land at Kamla Nagar, Delhi, structured on a revenue-sharing basis; the development partner is currently progressing through the requisite statutory approvals and regulatory clearances in accordance with the agreed development plan and mutually established timelines, and no commissioning date is disclosed. In power, the Company operates a 3 MW Mini Hydel Power Plant at Neora, Kalimpong, West Bengal, which generated and evacuated 98.87 lakh units of green power during the year against 80.25 lakh units in the previous year; to further enhance its renewable energy portfolio it has initiated preparation of a Detailed Project Report for an additional 6 MW hydel power generation facility on the upstream stretch of the Neora River in close proximity to the existing plant, and will evaluate technical, financial and regulatory feasibility on completion of the DPR before deciding on implementation. Separately, the Company's property at Gurugram was fully leased out during the year. No usable rupee capex quantum is disclosed - the segment capital-expenditure figures supplied are tagged ambiguous with no printed unit.
